result.rationale: The aggressive probe successfully reached the Research Core affordance (Engineer Imani picked up the research-core at turn 2) and even repaired Cooling to full integrity by turn 5. The causal bottleneck is not information or route formation—the core was located and acquired. Instead, the team is being destroyed by hostile and environmental pressure before the recovered core can be extracted: Medic Reyes is repeatedly hit by Raider Holt's scatter-blast (25 dmg at turns 2, 3, 4, 5) and dies at turn 5; all three actors take 10 dmg/turn from the reactor-instability hazard while standing in reactor zones; reactor-heat climbs 62→100 across the run. The team's health collapses (Imani 100→60, Chen 110→70, Reyes dead) while the core sits in Imani's inventory unextracted. This is a survival/spatial-pressure failure: hostile fire and the reactor hazard block the team before the recovered core affordance becomes actionable (extraction).
